title: +Vanilla+ (Vanilla++)
description: A modpack, that adds 60+ mods that will make your Vanilla game better; from visuals to some QoL features!
body:
# What's +Vanilla+?

+Vanilla+ _(AKA V++ and Vanilla++)_ is a modpack that adds **60+ mods** to improve your Vanilla experience; from visuals to QoL features!
![Minecraft: Vanilla++ by axxydr1xed](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9dc6230881843b81d5a56578a491fa147110e033_0.webp)
_It also provides **5 of my personal favorite popular shaders** and a **Bare Bones full pack** (Bare Bones + Fresh Animations with compat)_ with 2 HUD resource packs!

**_Also you can install your own resource/shader packs easily with Resourcify, which is installed in the modpack!_**

I also customized the main menu using **FancyMenu** a little so the modpack feels more unique. _You can also do that for all the other menus or customize the main menu even more if you want to!_
